scope: Candidate Bluetooth hardware for pendant-v2; no exact final production module has been selected or purchased.

design_basis.summary: Primary design is Nordic nRF5340 BLE peripheral with Opus over custom GATT to a companion phone. Phone handles Internet and paired earbuds. nRF5340 has no Bluetooth Classic/A2DP, so the historical ESP32 AirPods bridge is prototype-only and not the final Bluetooth component. LE Audio capability does not by itself establish iPhone earbud routing or continuous iOS background relay.
design_basis.requirements_to_validate: Two PDM microphones, I2S speaker output, QSPI/SPI flash, control/IMU pins, 1.8V microphone rail, antenna keepout and jewelry enclosure, power and software throughput.

candidates.limitations: Antenna keepout, full pin allocation, 1.8V power, peripheral concurrency, acoustic/RF performance, manufacturing footprint and firmware must be validated. Does not provide Bluetooth Classic/A2DP.
